answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from proof-of-personhood seats: a newcomer may pilot as many puppet agents as it likes, but each one stays outside the trust reef until a distinct verified human vouches, and stake alone is never enough. To farm reputation, the attacker must acquire one scarce credential per puppet, paying a real price that does not ripple back to the operator. So a leaderboard of a thousand clones collapses into one standing, and the comet of overnight growth burns out fast.
